source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 11: book page 296. The book prints no answers for Unit 11.

blocks.prompt: 11 (a) A quarterback throws a football with a position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 20t\,\hat{i} + (20t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\). Find the time of flight before it hits the ground.
blocks.explanation:
\(\hat{j}\) wala component football ki oonchai hai; football zameen par tab hai jab oonchai zero ho.
Diya kya hai? \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 20t\,\hat{i} + (20t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh waqt (zero ke ilawa) jab football zameen par girta hai.
Plan: \(20t - 4.9t^{2} = 0\) ko factorise karo aur \(t = 0\) (phenkne ka lamha) chhor do. Bilkul Question 6(c) jaisa.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 20t\,\hat{i} + (20t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\) (metres, seconds); oonchai \(y(t) = 20t - 4.9t^{2}\).
Maloom karna: time of flight \(T\).
Tareeqa: \(y(t) = 0\) hal karna.

Oonchai zero
\[20t - 4.9t^{2} = 0\]
\[t(20 - 4.9t) = 0\]
\[t = 0 \ \text{ or } \ t = \dfrac{20}{4.9} = \dfrac{200}{49}\]
Kyun: \(t\) common nikala; product zero tab hota hai jab koi ek factor zero ho. \(t = 0\) phenkne ka lamha hai, is liye girne ka waqt doosra root hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{20}{4.9}\) ko \(\frac{200}{49}\) likhna (upar neeche 10 se multiply) hisaab ko saaf rakhta hai.

Tasdeeq
\(y\left(\frac{200}{49}\right) = \frac{200}{49}\left(20 - 4.9 \cdot \frac{200}{49}\right) = \frac{200}{49}(20 - 20) = 0\), yani us waqt oonchai waqai zero hai.

blocks.prompt: 11 (b) A quarterback throws a football with a position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 20t\,\hat{i} + (20t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\). What is the maximum height reached?
blocks.explanation:
Sab se oonchi jagah par football sirf aage (horizontal) ja raha hota hai, upar ya neeche nahin; yani velocity ka \(\hat{j}\) wala hissa zero hota hai.
Diya kya hai? Oonchai \(y(t) = 20t - 4.9t^{2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Sab se zyada oonchai \(H\).
Plan: pehle woh waqt nikalo jab vertical velocity zero ho, phir us waqt ki oonchai \(y(t)\) mein rakh kar nikalo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y(t) = 20t - 4.9t^{2}\).
Maloom karna: maximum height \(H\).
Tareeqa: choti par \(\mathbf{v}\) ka \(\hat{j}\) component zero hota hai.

Velocity
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = 20\,\hat{i} + (20 - 9.8t)\hat{j}\]
Kyun: har component ko differentiate kiya; \(20t \to 20\), \(4.9t^{2} \to 9.8t\).

Choti ka waqt
\[20 - 9.8t = 0\]
\[t = \dfrac{20}{9.8} = \dfrac{100}{49} \approx 2.04 \text{ s}\]
Kyun: is waqt se pehle \(20 - 9.8t > 0\) (football upar ja raha hai) aur baad mein negative (neeche aa raha hai). Beech mein ek lamhe ke liye vertical raftaar zero hoti hai, jaise upar phenki gend choti par ek pal ruki lagti hai.

Maximum height
\[H = 20\left(\tfrac{100}{49}\right) - 4.9\left(\tfrac{100}{49}\right)^{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{2000}{49} - \dfrac{49000}{2401}\]
\[= \dfrac{2000}{49} - \dfrac{1000}{49}\]
\[= \dfrac{1000}{49} \approx 20.41 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: \(4.9 \times 10000 = 49000\), aur \(\frac{49000}{2401} = \frac{49 \times 1000}{49 \times 49} = \frac{1000}{49}\).
Dhyan dein: \(t = \frac{100}{49}\) ko \(y(t)\) mein rakhna hai, \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) mein nahin; velocity mein rakhne se to zero hi aayega.

Tasdeeq
\[H = \dfrac{u^{2}}{2g} = \dfrac{20^{2}}{2(9.8)}\]
\[= \dfrac{400}{19.6} \approx 20.41 \text{ m}\]
Yeh physics ke \(v^{2} = u^{2} - 2gH\) se aata hai, jahan shuru ki vertical raftaar \(u = 20\) m/s aur choti par \(v = 0\). Dono tareeqe ek hi jawab dete hain.

blocks.prompt: 11 (c) A quarterback throws a football with a position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 20t\,\hat{i} + (20t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\). At which time did football reach its maximum height?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh wohi waqt hai jab vertical velocity zero hoti hai, jo hum part (b) mein nikal chuke hain.
Diya kya hai? \(\mathbf{v}(t) = 20\,\hat{i} + (20 - 9.8t)\hat{j}\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh waqt jab football sab se ooncha hota hai.
Plan: \(20 - 9.8t = 0\) hal karo aur part (a) ke time of flight se muqabla kar ke check karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{v}(t) = 20\,\hat{i} + (20 - 9.8t)\hat{j}\).
Maloom karna: maximum height ka waqt.
Tareeqa: choti par vertical velocity zero hoti hai.

Hal
\[20 - 9.8t = 0\]
\[t = \dfrac{20}{9.8} = \dfrac{100}{49} \approx 2.04 \text{ s}\]
Kyun: part (b) wali hi baat: vertical velocity zero, yani na upar na neeche, sirf aage.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{100}{49} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \dfrac{200}{49}\]
Football bilkul aadhe time of flight par choti par pohanchta hai. Yeh theek hai, kyunke barabar zameen par path apni choti ke dono taraf ek jaisa (symmetric) hota hai: jitna waqt upar jaane mein laga, utna hi neeche aane mein.
blocks.final_answer: Football \(t = \frac{100}{49} \approx 2.04\) s par apni maximum height par pohanchta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.3 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (Unit 11 ki kisi exercise ke jawab kitab mein nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) jaise angles radians mein hain, is liye calculator RAD mode mein rakhein. Apna hal yahan wale hal se mila kar dekhiye.
